narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I say fifty one is prime, because it is an odd number.
<bookmark mark='lay'/>But three goes into fifty one exactly, seventeen times, so three is another factor.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Odd does not mean prime, so fifty one has more than two factors.
